
// ============================================================
// 全局脚本变量：信息类型标签→流量负载模型映射
// ============================================================
// 后端根据信息类型标签选择对应的流量负载模型参与链路计算
// 前端界面配置时，选择信息类型标签即可自动匹配负载模型
// ============================================================
script_variables
  // 信息类型标签枚举 —— 按合同术语命名
  string INFO_TYPE_FORWARD_SITUATION = "forward_situation";  // 前向态势信息
  string INFO_TYPE_FORWARD_TARGET    = "forward_target";     // 前向目标信息（含指令）
  string INFO_TYPE_BACK_RECON        = "back_recon";         // 返向侦察信息
  string INFO_TYPE_BACK_STATUS       = "back_status";        // 返向状态信息

  // 传输频次（秒）
  double FORWARD_SITUATION_FREQ_SEC  = 1.0;    // 前向态势：每秒1次
  double FORWARD_TARGET_FREQ_SEC     = 1.0;    // 前向目标：每秒1次
  double BACK_RECON_FREQ_SEC         = 10.0;   // 返向侦察：每10秒1次
  double BACK_STATUS_FREQ_SEC        = 5.0;    // 返向状态：每5秒1次

  // 时延要求（秒）
  double FORWARD_SITUATION_DELAY_SEC = 1.0;    // 前向态势时延≤1s
  double FORWARD_TARGET_DELAY_SEC    = 1.0;    // 前向目标时延≤1s
  double BACK_RECON_DELAY_SEC        = 2.0;    // 返向侦察时延≤2s
  double BACK_STATUS_DELAY_SEC       = 5.0;    // 返向状态时延≤5s
end_script_variables

// ============================================================
// 第1部分：天线方向图定义
// ============================================================

// ========== 微波链路（X/Ku） ==========
//普通集群任务无人机机载宽波束
antenna_pattern MICRO_UAV_OMNI_ANTENNA
    uniform_pattern
        peak_gain 3 dB
        azimuth_beamwidth 360 deg
        elevation_beamwidth 65 deg
    end_uniform_pattern
end_antenna_pattern

//后方公共服务平台地面车载微波定向
antenna_pattern MICRO_REAR_PLATFORM_DIR_ANTENNA
    uniform_pattern
        peak_gain 18 dB
        azimuth_beamwidth 12 deg
        elevation_beamwidth 12 deg
    end_uniform_pattern
end_antenna_pattern


// 1.1 全向天线（基础通信，0dB增益）
antenna_pattern OMNI_ANTENNA
    uniform_pattern
        peak_gain 30 dB
        azimuth_beamwidth 360 deg
        elevation_beamwidth 180 deg
    end_uniform_pattern
end_antenna_pattern

// 1.2 高增益全向天线（干扰站专用，8dB增益）
antenna_pattern OMNI_ANTENNA_HIGHGAIN
    uniform_pattern
        peak_gain 25 dB
        azimuth_beamwidth 360 deg
        elevation_beamwidth 180 deg
    end_uniform_pattern
end_antenna_pattern

// 1.3 C波段定向天线（指挥车专用，25dB增益，俯仰-3°~+85°）
antenna_pattern C_BAND_DIRECTIONAL_VEHICLE_ANTENNA
    uniform_pattern
      peak_gain 25 dB
      azimuth_beamwidth 360 deg
      elevation_beamwidth 88 deg
    end_uniform_pattern
end_antenna_pattern

// 1.3 C波段定向天线（无人机专用，25dB增益，俯仰-3°~+85°）
antenna_pattern C_BAND_DIRECTIONAL_UAV_ANTENNA
    uniform_pattern
      peak_gain 25 dB
      azimuth_beamwidth 360 deg
      elevation_beamwidth 88 deg
    end_uniform_pattern
end_antenna_pattern

// L波段新一代数传 集群指挥车定向跟踪天线
// 说明：方位360°×n连续、俯仰‑3°~+85°为伺服转台机械运动范围；天线电磁波为窄波束；仿真假定伺服始终对准目标
antenna_pattern L_BAND_DIRECTIONAL_VEHICLE_ANTENNA
    uniform_pattern
      peak_gain 25 dB
      azimuth_beamwidth 360 deg
      elevation_beamwidth 88 deg
    end_uniform_pattern
end_antenna_pattern

// L波段新一代数传 无人集群无人机机载全向天线
// 适配中小型无人机机动翻滚，无需伺服跟踪，水平360°全域覆盖
antenna_pattern L_BAND_DIRECTIONAL_UAV_ANTENNA
    uniform_pattern
      peak_gain 25 dB
      azimuth_beamwidth 360 deg
      elevation_beamwidth 88 deg
    end_uniform_pattern
end_antenna_pattern

// 1.4 卫星通信天线（25dB增益）
antenna_pattern SAT_COMM_ANTENNA
    uniform_pattern
      peak_gain 25 dB
      azimuth_beamwidth 360 deg
      elevation_beamwidth 180 deg
    end_uniform_pattern
end_antenna_pattern

// 地面车载卫星通信动中通天线（后方公共服务平台）
// 25dBi；方位360°、俯仰大角度为伺服转台机械运动范围；电磁波为窄波束；仿真假定伺服对准卫星
antenna_pattern SAT_GROUND_MOBILE_ANTENNA
    uniform_pattern
      peak_gain 25 dB
      azimuth_beamwidth 360 deg
      elevation_beamwidth 180 deg
    end_uniform_pattern
end_antenna_pattern

// 卫星星载对地通信点波束天线
antenna_pattern SAT_SPACE_BEAM_ANTENNA
    uniform_pattern
      peak_gain 30 dB
      azimuth_beamwidth 360 deg
      elevation_beamwidth 180 deg
    end_uniform_pattern
end_antenna_pattern

// 普通无人集群任务无人机 轻量化机载卫星通信宽波束天线
// 中小型集群无人机载荷受限，宽波束电扫覆盖卫星视域，无机械伺服
antenna_pattern SAT_UAV_CLUSTER_WIDEBAND_ANTENNA
  uniform_pattern
    peak_gain 30 dB
    azimuth_beamwidth 360 deg
    elevation_beamwidth 180 deg
  end_uniform_pattern
end_antenna_pattern

// 1.5 激光通信天线（窄波束，40dB增益，5°×5°）
antenna_pattern LASER_COMM_ANTENNA
    uniform_pattern
      peak_gain 40 dB
      azimuth_beamwidth 360 deg
      elevation_beamwidth 180 deg
    end_uniform_pattern
end_antenna_pattern

// ============================================================
// 第2部分：雷达散射截面积定义
// ============================================================

radar_signature DRONE_SIG
  constant 1.0 m^2
end_radar_signature

radar_signature COMMAND_VEHICLE_SIG
  constant 5.0 m^2
end_radar_signature

radar_signature SAT_SIG
  constant 3.0 m^2
end_radar_signature


// ============================================================
// 第3部分：网络拓扑定义
// ============================================================

network COM_MESH_NET WSF_COMM_NETWORK_MESH
  network_address 192.168.0.0/16
end_network

// 光缆专用点对点网络 — 后方节点 ↔ 集群指挥车节点
//network FIBER_NET WSF_COMM_NETWORK_MESH
//end_network

network FIBER_NET WSF_COMM_NETWORK_P2P
  /*comm_list
      member command_vehicle fiber_link
      member rear_comm_vehicle fiber_link
  end_comm_list*/
end_network

medium UAV_MESH_MEDIUM WSF_COMM_MEDIUM_UNGUIDED
    channels 4
    default_mode_name "default"
    mode "default"
      propagation_speed constant 299792458 m/sec
      transfer_rate constant 4000000 bit/s
      packet_loss_time constant 0 sec
    end_mode
end_medium

// 光缆介质定义
medium FIBER_MEDIUM WSF_COMM_MEDIUM_GUIDED
    channels 4
    default_mode_name "default"
    mode "default"
        propagation_speed constant 200000000 m/sec    // 光纤中光速约 2e8 m/s
        transfer_rate constant 1000000 bit/s          // 1Mbps
        packet_loss_time constant 0 sec
    end_mode
end_medium
